capabilities: search the vault with per-field weights for file names, folders, tags, headings, content, and quotes
configure search scope and excluded folders
insert matching text via the @@ trigger
insert links to matching headings via @@#
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is bilingual (English/Chinese) and documents that no data leaves the vault.
intentEvidence: an Obsidian plugin for weighted vault search and quick insertion of matching content, heading links, and block links
problem: Obsidian's built-in search and quick switcher treat all fields equally and don't offer weighted ranking or direct insertion of matching content, heading links, or block links.
summary: Weighted vault search plugin that ranks matches by per-field weights and inserts matching text, heading links, or block links.
